title: "3× the pay. Am I 3× better?"
reasons: Sukma Holiday: 1/9; Day 1 working & Client meetings: 2/9; Malaysia Day: 16/9
description:
It is time to face being an adult, after 4 years of university.

3× the pay compared to my internship. Am I 3× better now? Am I prepared?

In the working world, no one would care about emotions. All they care about is output.

The experience that I have from Presoft, hopefully, will be useful to me. My prompting skills (read: Antigravity) should be able to supplement my other shortcomings.

With adult money also comes adult bills. I should probably ask around and figure out what I'm supposed to pay sooner or later, before the tax people knock on my door, or some random expense I didn't know existed suddenly comes into existence.

Somehow, after spending four years trying to figure out how to survive university, I'm now expected to figure out how to survive adulthood. Surely nothing could go wrong.

So ready or not, here it comes.

Here I come.
